ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS (declared, fy_fact, period ended 2025-11-30) — the quarterly facts since and a year earlier are on different tags (declared/paid), so the year is not rolled forward
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2013-11-30..2025-11-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-08-31..2026-08-31, 20 facts); both tags file quarterly facts in the last 8 quarters ending 2026-08-31 and neither has stopped — declared is primary (paid becomes primary only when the declared tag has had no fact for 330 days while paid continues)
dividends.frequency_basis: spacing of the latest 4 positive quarterly DPS facts (2025-08-31, 2026-02-28, 2026-05-31, 2026-08-31) (the FY count — 2 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2024-12-01..2025-11-30) plus one payment carried only in the FY total — reads irregular); the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-30..2026-08-31
dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shares_source: quarter ended 2026-08-31 weighted-average diluted count, fallback: no undimensioned period-end / cover-page share count in EDGAR companyfacts (a dual-class filer's cover-page and balance-sheet counts are class-dimensioned and dropped by the API)
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-11-30..2026-08-31

dividend_yield.basis: FY2025 DPS (declared, fy_fact, period ended 2025-11-30) — the quarterly facts since and a year earlier are on different tags (declared/paid), so the year is not rolled forward

split adjustment (declared DPS): 21 facts for periods ending 2013-11-30..2018-11-30 were last filed before the 2-for-1 split effective 2021-01-28 (no ratio fact: the factor the filer re-filed its FY DPS and diluted share counts by) and are divided by the split ratio (filed, or evidenced by the re-filed values) to today's share basis

split adjustment (paid DPS): 38 facts for periods ending 2009-08-31..2018-11-30 were last filed before the 2-for-1 split effective 2021-01-28 (no ratio fact: the factor the filer re-filed its FY DPS and diluted share counts by) and are divided by the split ratio (filed, or evidenced by the re-filed values) to today's share basis

dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2013-11-30..2025-11-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2009-08-31..2026-08-31, 20 facts) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (181 days between 2025-08-31 and 2026-02-28) — FY2025 DPS (declared, fy_fact, period ended 2025-11-30) — the quarterly facts since and a year earlier are on different tags (declared/paid), so the year is not rolled forward
